planner_heuristic_statement: Dual-Track Asymmetric Ground-Truth & Lifespan Reconciliation Heuristic: (1) Operational Ground Truth Track: Present executable code, orchestration workflows, and runtime configurations define what the machine deterministically enforces today; neither specification text (Agents.md), descriptive skill documents, retired definitions, nor historical model self-reports constitute proof of executable enforcement. (2) Requirement Provenance & Lifespan Track: Historical Git lineage and persisted execution records establish the origin, evolution, and supersession of user requirements. Requirement lifecycle (Active vs. Partially Superseded vs. Fully Superseded) and implementation status (Deterministically Enforced vs. Partially Implemented vs. Unenforced/Missing vs. Misrepresented) are treated as orthogonal dimensions. Superseded requirements create no present corrective work. (3) Grounded Interpretation Layer: Every historical semantic decision must strictly follow raw facts -> interpretations -> truth decisions with explicit evidence locators. (4) Corrective Work Criterion: An outstanding gap exists if and only if a user requirement survives as active or partially active, yet today's executable machine fails to deterministically implement or enforce it.
